tests.title: A payment method switched off in Online Store settings cannot be used at checkout
tests.goal: Customers can only pay with methods the shop has enabled.
preconditions: Ask the user first: settings change on the shared staging shop (README > Testing permissions).
Only Bank Transfer may be used for orders; do not enable card or wallet gateways
data: Method to switch off: Bank Transfer (fn-bank-transfer) briefly, then back on

steps.text: Switch off Bank Transfer in the CRM
Reload checkout; then Proceed in the old tab with Bank Transfer still selected

expected.text: After reload Bank Transfer is not offered
The old tab is refused; no order is created with the disabled method
Cleanup: switch Bank Transfer back on and confirm checkout offers it
